name: @pipeworx/mcp-adzuna

tools.name: search
tools.description: "Find jobs / openings / roles / positions for [title] in [city]" / "remote [role] jobs" / "[language / framework] developer jobs" / "salary range for [role] in [country]" — search live job postings via Adzuna (global job-board aggregator). Filters: country (gb/us/ca/de/fr/...), title query, location, distance, salary band, full-time/permanent, posted recency. Returns ranked listings with title, company, location, salary, posted date.

max_days_old.description: Restrict to jobs posted in the last N days

tools.name: categories
tools.description: Fetch Adzuna's normalized job-category list for a country (e.g. engineering, sales, healthcare) — returns tag slugs and display names. Use to enumerate valid category values before calling history or regional_stats with a category filter.

tools.name: salary_histogram
tools.description: "What does [role] pay" / "salary distribution for [job]" / "average salary for [title] in [location]" / "wage histogram for [profession]" — wage distribution histogram for jobs matching a query. Use for salary benchmarking, comp negotiation research, market-rate analysis.

tools.name: top_companies
tools.description: "Who's hiring the most [role]" / "top employers for [job]" / "biggest hirers of [skill]" — companies posting the most jobs matching a query/location filter. Use for "who's hiring" analysis, competitive talent landscape.

tools.name: history
tools.description: "Job market trends" / "hiring trends in [category]" / "salary trends for [role]" / "is [field] hiring more / less than last year" — historical monthly time series for job volume and mean salary in a country, optionally filtered by location and category. Use for labor-market analysis, recession indicators, hiring-cycle research.

tools.name: regional_stats
tools.description: "Where are [role] jobs concentrated" / "which cities have the most [job]" / "regional job distribution for [category]" — current job counts broken down by region within a country. Use for "where should I move for this job" / "labor market concentration" questions.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-adzuna forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the adzuna pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
